comment: The DSP is Émilie Gillet's Marbles, vendored unchanged at eurorack/marbles; src/marmora.cpp is the Rack wrapper. Every jack is read with getVoltage() and written with setVoltage(), so the module is monophonic. The two clock inputs read high at 1.7V, marmora.cpp:314 and marmora.cpp:318, while the two reset inputs go through Rack SchmittTriggers at marmora.cpp:342 and marmora.cpp:343, whose default high threshold is 1V; neither figure is in the manual. The X spread input does three jobs: it offsets the spread knob at marmora.cpp:554, it supplies the sampled voltage in external processing mode at marmora.cpp:548, and it supplies the note being taught while a scale is being edited at marmora.cpp:592. The manual's control diagram numbers the X external clock input as 10 in one place and 12 in another; the panel has one such jack.
